segments.name: Nigeria
segments.description: Owns and operates towers and fiber in Nigeria, leasing shared communications infrastructure to mobile network operators and other customers.
segments.evidence: Our three operating segments are Nigeria, which comprises our operations in Nigeria; Sub Saharan Africa, or SSA, which comprises our operations in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, South Africa, Zambia (and, until October 9, 2025, Rwanda); and Latin America, or Latam, which comprises our operations in Brazil and Colombia.

segments.name: Sub Saharan Africa
segments.description: Owns and operates towers in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, South Africa and Zambia, leasing shared infrastructure to mobile network operators.
segments.evidence: Our three operating segments are Nigeria, which comprises our operations in Nigeria; Sub Saharan Africa, or SSA, which comprises our operations in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, South Africa, Zambia (and, until October 9, 2025, Rwanda); and Latin America, or Latam, which comprises our operations in Brazil and Colombia.

segments.name: Latin America
segments.description: Owns and operates towers and fiber in Brazil and Colombia, serving mobile network operators and broadband customers.
segments.evidence: These disposal groups comprised the entire Latam reportable segment and therefore this segment was presented as a discontinued operation.

revenueModel.text: Mobile network operators and other communications service providers pay long-term lease fees for tower space, colocation, lease amendments and related services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary customers are the leading MNOs in each of our markets.

changes.text: In 2025 Middle East and North Africa ceased to be a reportable segment because the company no longer has operations there.
changes.evidence: From January 1, 2025 MENA, which comprised of the Middle East and North Africa, is not a reportable segment as we no longer have operations there.

changes.text: In 2025 the Latin America segment was presented as a discontinued operation after its tower and fiber disposal groups were classified as held for sale.
changes.evidence: The Latin American tower operations and I-Systems disposal groups were classified as held for sale at December 31, 2025.

changes.text: In 2025 Rwanda left the Sub Saharan Africa segment following its disposal.
changes.evidence: Until October 9, 2025 this business segment also included Rwanda.
